      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Behavior

A scroll handler reads scroll progress within the wrapper (0 → 1), sets a translate3d(0, -X%, 0) on .ds-solutions-left-stack where X scales with progress, toggles .is-active on the matching right-column art, syncs the active progress dot, and applies/removes inert on non-active left panels (Convention C9, accessibility).

Mobile branch (matched via matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)')) clears the inert attribute on all panels and disables the scroll handler entirely — panels render inline.

Surface variants

The template flips dark / light via the parent .ds-section--dark/--light modifier. The right-column art frame, the eyebrow icons, the heading colors, and the body copy all surface-adapt. The progress dots adapt too: muted grey on light, muted-on-dark grey on dark; the active dot is always brand orange.

When to use

Narrative sections where 3–5 sequential ideas earn an extended pinned scroll moment ("here are the four solutions we power"). Don't use for navigation, comparison tables, or quick-scan content. Cap at 1 instance per page.

Closing CTA — particle field

Deprecated v2.2.2
Superseded by Pre-footer ASCII band. The latest Company + Developers pages (May 2026) close with the "To see is to know" ASCII illustration band instead of the orange-particle closer. This template is preserved here for one release before final removal. Migrate existing pages to the Pre-footer ASCII band template.

Full-bleed closing section with a 2D canvas particle background behind heading + lead + CTA pair. ~150 free-flowing dots animate via requestAnimationFrame; respects prefers-reduced-motion (renders frame 0 only) and pauses the loop when the section scrolls off-screen via IntersectionObserver.

Anatomy

<section class="ds-section ds-section--dark ds-closing">
  <canvas class="ds-closing__particles" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="ds-closing__inner">
    <div class="ds-section-heading ds-section-heading--centered">
      <h2 class="ds-section-heading__title">VideoDB turns continuous media…</h2>
      <p class="ds-section-heading__lead">Start building with the SDK…</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ds-cta-pair">
      <a class="ds-btn ds-btn--primary" href="#">Start building</a>
      <a class="ds-btn ds-btn--ghost-dark" href="#">Talk to us</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Behavior

The canvas particle init creates ~150 dot particles with randomized velocity, draws them every frame with additive blending. Particle color is sampled from a data-surface attribute on the canvas ("dark" → white dots, "light" → black dots) so the same component works on both surfaces. IntersectionObserver pauses the rAF loop when the canvas is off-screen. Reduced-motion users see no particles at all (early return at init).

When to use

The final section before the footer on long marketing pages where the closing wants atmospheric weight. One per page, max. Avoid pairing with a ds-particle-dome hero on the same page — two motion focal points compete for attention.

<section class="ds-section ds-section--light" id="developers">
  <div class="ds-frame">
    <span class="ds-eyebrow ds-eyebrow--orange ds-eyebrow--xs ds-eyebrow--loose">Developer experience</span>
    <div class="ds-section-heading ds-section-heading--light">
      <h2 class="ds-section-heading__title">One command…</h2>

      <div class="ds-dev-grid">
        <div>
          <ul class="ds-feature-list">…</ul>
          <div class="ds-cta-pair">…</div>

      </div>
    </div>

Composition

  • .ds-dev-frame — the bordered container. Auto-tints based on parent section's --dark / --light. Mobile drops padding 40 → 24.
  • .ds-dev-grid — 2-col layout (1fr 1fr, 48px gap). Stacks to 1-col below 720px.
  • Left column: .ds-feature-list + .ds-cta-pair
  • Right column: .ds-code-block with the --animated modifier (typewriter init)

When to use

The "show me how to use it" fold on a developer landing page — lifts what would otherwise be a wall of code into a recognizable install-then-show unit. The bordered frame is what makes it work; without it the feature list and code block look like two unrelated columns. Section heading stays outside the frame so the heading belongs to the page rhythm, the frame belongs to its content.

Changelog · v2.3

v2.3 — website → DS reconciliation NEW

The consolidated June website feedback (validated against the live Design/Staging build) was cross-checked against this repo and the gaps were back-ported. The repo was not broadly behind — ~39 of 40 component families were already canonical; v2.3 closes the real gaps: foundation tunings, the net-new June component roster + JS utilities, the ap-doc long-form reader, and 9 new rules.

Foundation tunings

  • Eyebrow xs .ds-eyebrow--xs — 10 → 12px (the legibility-floor fix).
  • Section heading title .ds-section-heading__title — line-height 1.1 → 1.375; font-size now fluid clamp(26px, 4.5vw, 40px) (desktop unchanged at 40px).
  • Feature-tile body .ds-feature-tile__desc — 13/1.55 → 14/1.65.
  • Compare-card row tag .ds-compare-card__row-tag — two clashing definitions collapsed to one canonical 12px rule.
  • Hero stat label .ds-hero__big-stat-label — added line-height: 1.7.

New tokens

  • --ds-ease-canonical + --ds-duration-hover — the canonical hover curve (previously hand-typed) and its 280ms duration.
  • --color-success — #1f9d55, unifies two hardcoded form greens.
  • --text-on-dark-strong / --text-on-light-strong — the missing emphasis text tier.
  • --surface-illus-base / -sunken / -raised — the illustration-surface stack (#121212 / #0c0c0c / #1c1c1c).
  • .ds-hero__display--lg / .ds-hero__lead--compact — content-heavy hero modifiers.

Back-ports (were website-only, now canonical)

  • .ds-section-heading--display — CSS shipped (was doc-only in the repo), clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px), lh 1.05.
  • .ds-code-block--syntax — scoped .c / .k / .s / .n token colours, dark + light.
  • .ds-feature-tile-grid--4col — the 4-up rule + responsive collapse (4 → 2 @900 → 1 @560).

New atoms

  • .ds-conn / .ds-pipeline-connector — pure HTML/CSS pipeline connector (line + arrowhead + streaming dots) that replaces decorative arrow SVGs.
  • .ds-flow-tagline, .ds-text-accent, .ds-heading-second-dark / --light, .ds-snippet__value, .ds-code-block__action, .ds-code-block__cursor--thin.

New molecules

  • .ds-illustration-card (+ --dark / --grid), .ds-choice-card + .ds-choice-grid, .ds-page-crumb, .ds-media-text, .ds-ticker-tile.
  • .ds-result-preview, .ds-chat-row, .ds-action-tile, .ds-source-thumbnail, .ds-player-mockup, .ds-stat-card__inner, .ds-callout--accent-orange.

New templates

  • .ds-stage-grid, .ds-note-grid, .ds-code-split, .ds-card-pipe, .ds-viz — grid / code / pipeline composition patterns.
  • Scroll-driven: .ds-split-sticky, .ds-spotlight-list, .ds-sticky-wipe (each with a JS controller).
  • Plus the reverse photo ticker (.ds-marquee__track--reverse), .ds-img-reveal--desaturate, .ds-form-section__wrap, .ds-cta-band__inner--wide, .ds-section--no-bottom-pad, the code-block --glass / --prose / --fill variants, and the .ds-balance utility.

JS utilities

  • Ship in scripts/ds/: ds-form-submit.js (in-page Formspark state machine), ds-spotlight.js, ds-sticky-wipe.js, ds-marquee.js (smoothPause), ds-proximity-hover.js, ds-snippet-copy.js, and verify-widows.mjs (a CI widow linter).

ap-doc long-form reader

  • .ap-doc (+ --dark) — the canonical article / legal reading system, shared by the blog and legal pages (terms, privacy, security, DPA). Editorial titles now use Geist — the off-system GT Walsheim Pro was removed.

New rules (§9 of the spec)

  • Borders. Decorative dashes → solid hairlines, with three sanctioned exceptions (tooltip underline, focus outline, the dotted "pending" connector edge).
  • Opacity discipline (dim via a token / HSL shift, not opacity); the form-submit state machine (.ds-btn.is-sending / .is-success / .is-error); the SVG-illustration checklist; diagram foundations; concentric corner-radius; figure { margin: 0 }; and the page-local token-shadow caveat.
Changelog · v2.2.2

v2.2.2 — company + developers page lift NEW

Foundation tunings + 5 new molecules + 5 new organisms + 4 new templates + 1 new convention, all lifted from the May 2026 Company & Developers page revamps on videodb-website (104 pin-driven feedback items across two pages). One existing template deprecated (Closing CTA — particle field) and moved to the new Stale folder.

Foundation re-tunings

  • Scroll reveal .ds-reveal — 400ms → 720ms, travel 12 → 18px, deeper outQuint easing. Reads "comfy & elegant" vs prior "abrupt".
  • Reveal · slow modifier .ds-reveal--slow — NEW. 50px / 1500ms for ceremonial entrances (footer prelude ASCII).
  • Vertical bar bullet .ds-vbar — opacity halved (0.6 → 0.3, orange 1.0 → 0.5). Quieter in dense stacks.
  • Section heading lead .ds-section-heading__lead — 18 → 16px base. Quieter supporting line.
  • Footer .ds-footer — border-top: 0 + gradient fill (dark #000 → --neutral-darker, light #FFF → --white). Seamless transition from the preceding section.
  • Mobile frame .ds-frame — padding 20 → 32px @ ≤640px. Matches desktop default; very-small phones ≤380px keep 16px.
  • Mobile hero lead .ds-hero__lead — 18 → 16px @ ≤768px. Keeps subcopy from out-shouting the title.

New modifiers + composite

  • .ds-section--blend-to-footer — gradient bg fade into the following footer. Use on Subscribe Bands & tall-visual sections above the footer.
  • .ds-footer__prelude-ascii — container for the ASCII illustration that lives inside the footer prelude. Canvas attribute baseline (resolution=220, font-size=9, color=#FFFFFF on dark).
  • .ds-subscribe-band — wrapper that auto-pills any nested .ds-input radius. No .ds-input--pill modifier needed inside.

New conventions

  • C11 · text-selection palette. main ::selection — body text selects to neutral grey; h1-h4 + .ds-hero__display + .ds-section-heading__title select to --orange-500 with white text. Two rules MUST live in separate selectors (browsers drop the whole chain on unknown ::selection variants).

New molecules

  • Recap grid .ds-recap-grid — 5-tile bento w/ random-stagger reveal.
  • Recap report .ds-recap-report — month + flex-end stat row, 2×2 mobile.
  • Iframe wrap .ds-iframe-wrap — fixed-width 880px container for calendar / video / form embeds.
  • Careers list .ds-careers-list — layout-only definition-list for job rows.
  • Key-value list .ds-kv-list — layout-only 2-col label/body rows with hover tint.
  • Digest form .ds-digest-form — Subscribe Band variant w/ side visual.

New organisms

  • Investor card .ds-investor-card — circular avatar + name + bio card.
  • Partner card .ds-partner-card — height-locked logo card for design partners.
  • Showcase card .ds-showcase-card — 3-up media card ("Built on VideoDB").
  • Community ticker .ds-community-ticker — testimonial marquee variant w/ press-and-hold slow.
  • Quickstart tabs .ds-quickstart-tabs — multi-body code block w/ per-tab typewriter + active-tab clipboard.

New templates

  • Pre-footer ASCII band — "To see is to know" + ASCII illustration. THE canonical brand sign-off.
  • Recap band — bento photos + month/stats report.
  • Showcase 3-up — "Built on VideoDB" media-card row.
  • Hero with dome — hero composition + particle dome + stats strip + cascade reveal.

Updated

  • Onboarding — right-column code block now has typewriter on load (data-ds-typewriter).
  • Subscribe band — pill radius baked into canonical .ds-subscribe-band wrapper.

Deprecated (moved to Stale)

  • Closing CTA — particle field — superseded by Pre-footer ASCII band. Kept one release before removal.

Counts

  • Atoms: 19 (no change)
  • Molecules: 15 → 21 (+6)
  • Organisms: 38 → 43 (+5)
  • Templates: 13 → 17 (+4 new, 1 to Stale, kept active per user direction: lifecycle-grid, use-case-row, cta-band, onboarding)
  • Conventions: 10 → 11 (+1)
  • Engine extensions: 2 (particle gradient hook, hero-cascade decorator)
  • Showcase chrome: code-name chips on every preview + Anatomy <pre> restyle globalized
Molecules / Recap grid

Recap grid

5-tile bento photo grid for "what we've been up to" sections. Tall-right column, left mosaic. Tiles fade + lift in via .is-loaded added by JS in random order, 100ms apart ([data-ds-bento-stagger]). Mobile collapses to a stacked 2-col layout.

on-dark · ds-recap-grid · drag the right edge of the box below 768px to test the mobile reflow

<div class="ds-recap-grid" data-ds-bento-stagger>
  <div class="ds-recap-grid__tile ds-recap-grid__tile--p1"><img src="photo-1.jpg" /></div>
  <div class="ds-recap-grid__tile ds-recap-grid__tile--p2"><img src="photo-2.jpg" /></div>

</div>

When to use

Photo recap sections. "Last month at VideoDB" / "Community in pictures" / event recaps. Cap at 1 instance per page. Always 5 tiles — the bento template-areas grid expects p1–p5 keys.

Stagger via IO. data-ds-bento-stagger on the wrapper triggers a one-shot IntersectionObserver that adds .is-loaded to each tile in shuffled order, 100ms apart.

Organisms / Quickstart tabs

Quickstart tabs

Multi-body code block: 3 (or more) <pre> bodies, one per tab. Tab swap via [data-active-tab] on the host; per-body typewriter re-runs on tab activate; active-tab clipboard via the host's data-ds-typewriter-text. The original tabbed copy snippet pattern, generalized for tutorial / quickstart contexts where each tab is a real different command (python vs node vs skill install), not just a syntax variant.

Preview

on-light · ds-quickstart-tabs · canonical from developers.html

npm install videodb
npx skills add video-db/skills
Live · quickstart · v2.4.0

When to use

Multi-runtime install rows. When the three (or more) tabs are genuinely different commands — not the same call in different syntaxes. For syntax-only variants of the same operation, use the simpler code tab pills molecule.

Active-tab clipboard. The Copy button reads from host.dataset.dsTypewriterText, updated by the tab handler on every activate, so paste always matches the visible tab.

Templates / Pre-footer ASCII band

Pre-footer ASCII band brand sign-off

"To see is to know." + ASCII-rendered hand illustration. THE canonical pre-footer pattern across every videodb.io page (Company, Developers, Platform, Index, Solutions). Replaces the older particle-field closing CTA template (now deprecated). Uses .ds-reveal--slow for the ceremonial slide-up entrance (50px / 1500ms) and the .ds-footer__prelude-ascii container so the canvas sits flush with the footer below it.

Preview

To see is to know.

Anatomy

<section class="ds-section ds-section--dark">
  <div class="ds-frame" style="text-align: center;">
    <span class="ds-eyebrow ds-eyebrow--xs ds-eyebrow--loose">— vid · veda · video —</span>
    <h2 class="ds-prelude-tagline">To see is <span>to know.</span></h2>
    <div class="ds-footer__prelude-ascii ds-reveal--slow" data-ds-reveal>
      <canvas data-resolution="220" data-color="#FFFFFF"
              data-background="#050505" data-font-size="9"></canvas>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Canvas attribute baseline

  • data-resolution="220" — character density. Tuned for legibility at 9px glyph size.
  • data-font-size="9" — pixel size of each glyph cell.
  • data-color="#FFFFFF" on dark surfaces; swap to a dark hex on light footers.
  • data-background MUST mirror the parent footer surface (--neutral-darker on dark, --white on light) — mismatch produces an edge halo.

When to use

Every long-form page closes here. Cap at 1 instance per page. The hand-rendered ASCII is the visual signature of the brand — it lives at the end so the page resolves on it. Pair with the .ds-footer base (which now has border-top: 0 + gradient fill) so the transition into the footer is seamless.

Templates / Hero with dome

Hero with dome

Hero composition + particle dome (Three.js, opt-in vertex-color gradient) + stats strip via ds-stats Data Viz primitive + per-child cascade reveal (~120ms apart). The canonical hero for Developers, Platform, Company pages. Dark surface canonical.

Preview

For developers

Video infrastructure for the agent era.

One install. One key. Every video API your agent needs — search, memory, edits, streaming.

2.4MHours indexed
240msP95 query
99.97%Uptime
14×Cheaper

Anatomy

<section class="ds-section ds-section--dark" id="hero">
  <div class="ds-frame">
    <div class="ds-hero">
      <span class="ds-hero-pill">For developers</span>
      <h1 class="ds-hero__display">Video infrastructure
        <span>for the agent era.</span></h1>
      <p class="ds-hero__lead">One install. One key…</p>
      <div class="ds-feature-tile-grid ds-feature-tile-grid--4col">
        <div class="ds-stat ds-stat--dark">
          <span class="ds-stat__value" data-ds-count-up>2.4M</span>
          <span class="ds-stat__label">Hours indexed</span>
        </div>
        <!-- 3 more stats -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div data-ds-particle-dome data-ds-particle-scale="hero"
       data-ds-particle-gradient="grey-white"></div>
</section>

Behavior

  • Cascade reveal. Auto-applied by decorateReveals() when the section has id="hero". Each direct child of the inner hero container gets data-ds-reveal + data-ds-reveal-delay="N*120".
  • Particle dome. Three.js loaded on demand. data-ds-particle-gradient="grey-white" opts into the per-vertex gradient (white top → grey bottom). Omit the attr for a single-color dome.
  • Stats count-up. Each .ds-stat__value with data-ds-count-up animates from 0 → target on first viewport entry.
